title: How Wix Headless Works: A Plain-English Guide for Website Owners
seoTitle: How Wix Headless Works: A Plain-English Guide
seoDescription: Wix Headless keeps your store, bookings, blog and members in Wix while a custom front end shows them. See login, hosting, cost and when it's worth it.
excerpt: The data flow in one table, the four login credentials (client ID, tokens, secret, API key) explained simply, Wix-managed vs self-managed hosting, migration catches, and when the editor is still the better choice.
